sergeant_dec5f454.text: The Captain's down! Hold them — hold them!

you_1bb44cc7.text: Hello…? Anyone? …Where the hell is my unit?

you_386a51d6.text: Greycoats! My rifle — where's my rifle?!

you_4ddf8d42.text: And that was my last round. Great. Just the sabre, then.

you_ab326a24.text: A road. Finally… it's got to lead somewhere.

you_05a52819.text: Scouts. The Dominion's crawling all over these woods…

sentry1_f31168f8.text: Halt! Who goes there? Show your face!

you_74fba966.text: Easy! Easy — don't shoot! I'm… I think I'm one of you!

sentry2_a98fe51f.text: Wait — burgundy tabs on his collar… He's one of ours! Open the gate!

captain_06e7aa1d.text: Easy, soldier. Easy. Lower the blade… you're among friends now.

you_d0ff95ae.text: Friends? I… I woke up in the Thornwood. No memory. No unit. Just greycoats, waiting for me.

captain_27b49481.text: Kharzan raiders. They hit our patrol two nights ago… We thought nobody walked out of those woods.

sergeant_08390413.text: Captain — look at his collar. Burgundy tabs. Seventh Company… he's one of ours, sir.

captain_e279d1cf.text: Then welcome home, soldier. Whatever you lost out there… we'll help you find it.

youThought_6f1e46b4.text: (They know this uniform. They're on my side… I think.)

captain_f8875a97.text: Dell! Get this man a proper weapon — that sabre won't hold back the Dominion.

quartermaster_ddb3255b.text: Aye, sir! Over here, friend — I've got just the thing for you.

quartermaster_4d2d56b0.text: There she is. Rkm Model 28. Twenty rounds a box, and she'll chew through 'em fast — so short bursts, yeah?

sentry2_1c514289.text: Captain! Movement in the treeline — greycoats, dozens of them!

captain_1caf8171.text: KHARZANS! Everyone to the walls — hold this fort!

sergeant_d078ebf7.text: There's too many of them! They're through the wall!

soldier_9956dcef.text: We can't hold them! We can't—

kharzanOfficer_c896cf0a.text: Hm. This one's still breathing… Velmoran. Seventh Company.

kharzanOfficer_c639cdd3.text: Take him alive. The Marshal will want to question him.

marshal_c3eeb012.text: Ah… you're awake. Good. I was beginning to think my men had been too enthusiastic.

marshal_0c088383.text: Fort Velmar is ash. Your captain is dead. And you, my friend, are all that is left of it.

marshal_244d6f07.text: So I will ask you one question… and I will ask it only once.

marshal_63c4e006.text: Where are Velmoran Headquarters? Tell me… or die.

you_52d967c9.text: I don't know. I can't even remember my own name.

you_f90d995e.text: Corran Mill. East, past the river crossing.

marshal_8fc2b707.text: No memory? How convenient. Men remember quickly… when the alternative is a bullet.

marshal_b146817e.text: Corran Mill burned a month ago, boy. By my order. Lie to someone who was not there.

marshal_68d5fa45.text: Hell? Look around you. You are already there.

marshal_315fa9a5.text: Silence. The bravest answer… and the most foolish.

marshal_7ab75b62.text: Enough. Sergeant — take him outside. Make it quick.

kharzan_e92ebf34.text: Marshal! Listen — aircraft, from the south!

marshal_8fed471b.text: Velmoran bombers? This far north? That's impossible—

marshal_cc4efa01.text: Wait— wait! I surrender! I can give you names, positions—

lieutenant_d0a7343a.text: On your feet, Seventh. The General wants a word with you.

soldier_413db347.text: Burn it! Burn all of it!

lieutenant_bfe93352.text: Torch the barracks — nothing left standing!

scout_18938bcb.text: Please — please, I have a family—

general_b805b729.text: So. You're the one from Fort Velmar. The only one, from what I hear.

you_d947f279.text: You came for me… all of this… for me?

general_bb2d811a.text: For you? Son… we came for these.

general_541ecff8.text: Kharzan war plans. Every division, every depot, their whole spring offensive… from here to the coast.

you_c9b12c46.text: And the men in there? They surrendered.

general_a0b027d1.text: You were a convenient excuse, soldier. A rescue gives the men something to believe in.

general_11c35f11.text: After all… why risk so many soldiers' lives for one man?

general_5b459dec.text: You. Seventh. I have a job for you.

general_83355af5.text: These plans go to Command at Hollin Ridge. East, along the old road. Two days on foot, if you don't sleep.

general_54dc0562.text: My men stay here to hold the ruins. You go alone. Nobody notices one soldier on a road.

general_07aeeed5.text: Then burn them. And don't get stopped.

general_ebcfbaa5.text: One more thing, soldier. The seal stays unbroken. Those pages are for Command's eyes only.

soldier_943e9378.text: Your sabre, and a rifle. Twenty rounds. Make them count.

bandit_d1c1d72b.text: Well, look what the road brought us. Leave the satchel, soldier, and maybe you keep your boots.

youThought_d38cea1a.text: (Command's eyes only. That's what he said.)

youThought_d49b4906.text: (After Kharsk… I don't know whose eyes I trust anymore.)

youThought_cdaff2ff.text: (Not my war to read. Just get it there.)

youThought_d404e0ab.text: (Operation Iron Tide… Hollin Ridge. They're going to hit Command.)

youThought_efc0aa54.text: (Two days on the road, and the guns open on the third. I'd walk in just in time to die with them.)

youThought_4fc96e5f.text: (Whatever they did at Kharsk… the men at Hollin Ridge don't deserve to burn.)

youThought_acf7ff8f.text: (They shot men on their knees. Let Command find out what that feels like.)

bandit_9bd818ee.text: There he is — the courier! The greycoats pay gold for that satchel!

you_3caacc9b.text: Kharzan bounties on couriers… just like the plans said.

you_59d42523.text: Seventh Company. Dispatches from General Morrow, for Command.

you_b413aa55.text: From General Morrow, sir. For Command's eyes only.

colonel_66682281.text: Morrow. Of course. Put it with the others — Command will read it in the morning.

you_c806a9ed.text: Sir, the General said it was—

colonel_c00cb494.text: Everything Morrow sends is urgent, soldier. Get some food. Get some sleep. You've earned it.

soldier_a4dd0a2a.text: KHARZANS! On the walls — they're everywhere!

you_de7bfd69.text: Colonel — the Kharzans are coming. Here, to Hollin Ridge. In two days.

colonel_3932017e.text: And how would a private know that?

you_a3f1d9cf.text: I broke the seal. It's all in there. Operation Iron Tide.

colonel_39b65eb5.text: Ring the bell! Every man on the walls, every gun on the west road. Now!

colonel_272d2575.text: You broke a sealed order, soldier. On another night, I'd have you shot.

colonel_400357a3.text: Tonight… you may have saved every man in this fort. What's your name?

general_f260005b.text: Back already, Seventh? Command has the plans?

you_83ddf914.text: Delivered, sir. Into the Colonel's own hands.

general_d6253560.text: Good. Then we've done our part.

youThought_6dc0cd4b.text: (The folder's still inside my coat. The seal's still broken.)

soldier_2621e745.text: General! Signal from Hollin Ridge — the Kharzans hit them at dawn. They're gone, sir. Nobody saw it coming.

colonel_6757630e.text: Two days. You gave us two days, soldier. We used every hour of them.

colonel_9d1be22d.text: A moat across the west road. Mines in the fields. Wire on every approach. Let them come.

sentry1_eecf307d.text: Movement on the west road! Kharzan columns — hundreds of them!

colonel_ab39a648.text: To your posts! Hold your fire until they reach the mines!

soldier_a29a1d0c.text: Mines! They've walked into the mines!

colonel_16fce0ff.text: Hold the line! Make them pay for every yard!

colonel_750504c2.text: Iron Tide broke on Hollin Ridge. Remember this morning — every one of you.

colonel_4f378420.text: As for you, Seventh: Morrow's legion is camped at Kharsk. You're to report back to your unit.

armorer_7c0f5aa3.text: That sabre's notched to the hilt, friend. Take this instead — double-bladed, Hollin steel.

armorer_01863b45.text: It won't bend. Neither should you.

varek_ba0bf2be.text: You. Velmoran. Seventh Company tabs, a bandage on your head… I know you.

varek_a1acdae7.text: You walked out of Kharsk Keep while it burned. My brothers were in that keep. All of them.

varek_a5e3c6b0.text: You walked past them. It is the same thing.

varek_44e9b600.text: Put the rifle down. Face me with steel, like a soldier — or are you only brave from a distance?

varek_62d1bb7b.text: Enough… enough! I yield. I yield!

varek_635ad269.text: Go on, then… finish it. Like you finished Kharsk.

youThought_02676366.text: (He surrendered. Then he went for my throat. I didn't have a choice.)

youThought_45fe507b.text: (…Did I? He was on his knees. So were the men at Kharsk.)

youThought_92964e72.text: (I called Morrow's men murderers for that. What does that make me?)

youThought_a567d812.text: (The patrol in the clearing. Five men. I never even saw their faces.)

youThought_78e40e4d.text: (The scouts on the road. The walls at Velmar. The checkpoint. The bandits. I stopped counting somewhere.)

youThought_9a9f6d61.text: (Every one of them had a name. I don't even have mine.)

youThought_5e52c84b.text: (Maybe that's why it comes so easy.)

youThought_e428d552.text: (They'd have killed me. Every one of them. That's what I keep telling myself.)

youThought_f7e7855d.text: (But he was right about one thing. I walked past those fires.)

youThought_ce18ca5c.text: (…Is this who I was? Before I woke up in that forest?)

youThought_6830f91e.text: (Whoever I was… I'm not sure I want to find him.)

corporal_e99c6349.text: Seventh! You made it back! They're saying you held Hollin Ridge!

general_ae62c7f3.text: Hollin Ridge stands, I hear. Iron Tide broke on their wire.

general_45bd06b4.text: And I hear my seal was broken.

general_d79d0c9f.text: Get some sleep, soldier. Tomorrow, you and I are going to talk.
